# Load in jsonlite package
library(jsonlite)
library(dplyr)
#Assign Node Data and get a snapshot
datausers_nominal <- stream_in(file("/Users/alexgould/Downloads/genius-expertise/user_info.json"))
head(datausers)
data_annotate <- stream_in(file(("/Users/alexgould/Downloads/genius-expertise/annotation_info.json")))
head(data_annotate)
songinfo <-  stream_in(file(("/Users/alexgould/Downloads/genius-expertise/song_info.json")))
head(songinfo)


# Assign Edge Data
edges_nominal <- read.csv("genius-expertise/follows.csv")
dim(edges)
length(unique(edges$follower))
length(unique(edges$following))



#Make Dataset with only users in node dataset and who are also contained 
# in folower and following

valid_users <- intersect(
  unique(data_annotate$user[!is.na(data_annotate$user)]),
  intersect(
    intersect(unique(datausers_nominal$url_name),
              unique(edges_nominal$follower)),
    unique(edges_nominal$following)
  )
)
edges_reduced <- data.frame()
edges_reduced <- edges_nominal[edges_nominal$follower %in% valid_users &
                                 edges_nominal$following %in% valid_users,
                               c("follower", "following")]
stopifnot(all(unlist(edges_reduced) %in% nodes_reduced$url_name))
dim(edges_reduced)

valid_nodes <- datausers_nominal[datausers_nominal$url_name %in% valid_users, ]

valid_annotate <- data_annotate[data_annotate$user %in% valid_users, ]


nodes_reduced <- merge(valid_nodes, valid_annotate, by.x = "url_name",
                       by.y = "user", all.x = TRUE)
dim(nodes_reduced)

#Infeasible to cast to wide because of the amount of songs per user
nodes_r <- nodes_reduced %>% 
            group_by(url_name) %>%
            slice_max(votes, n=1, with_ties = F)%>%
  ungroup()
#Clear empty columns
nodes_r <- as.data.frame(nodes_r[,setdiff(names(nodes_r), c("acceptor", "artist"))])
#Change classes of vectors 
nodes_r <- cbind(nodes_r[, names(nodes_r) != "stats"], nodes_r$stats)
nodes_r$roles <- unlist(nodes_r$roles)

g <- graph_from_data_frame(d= edges_reduced, directed = T, vertices = nodes_r)
